AzureAdCiam._comment: XD01-385: the município grant endpoints' ip-billing:reference-manage check is the kernel's answer for the caller's own token (forwarded to the kernel's /api/identity/me), so the kernel must accept that token: use the kernel's API audience here (as GeoAssets.NeutralOperator.Server does), or have the kernel accept this audience too.

GeoCoreServer._comment: The kernel's ROOT URL (no /api/geoassets suffix; XD01-385 aligned this host with GeoAssets.NeutralOperator.Server). Features (/api/geoassets), the generic organization-grant API and the permission registration (/api/identity) and the caller's identity are all reached under it.

ServiceAuth._comment: XD01-299: client credentials of this host's GeoAssets.ServiceCaller service principal. Disabled (the default) registers no token provider: the kernel's machine-to-machine routes then answer 401 — the município grant sync/revoke fail (500) and the vertical-registration check stays Degraded (/healthz still 200, /readyz 503).

VerticalRegistration._comment: XD01-385: retry schedule of the bootstrap registration of this vertical's permissions (PUT /api/identity/verticals/ip-billing/permissions; exponential backoff with jitter from InitialDelay to MaxDelay until it succeeds), then republished every RefreshInterval.
